verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents an in-app compliance dashboard showing company status per state, with state expansion handled from that dashboard, plus in-app digitization of incoming mail. Together these cover state registrations and received documents in one place. Nothing in the evidence shows managing multiple entities under one account or giving a team shared access. Missing for 10: multi-entity management within a single account, team/multi-user access and permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access

citations.quote: Get an instant overview of your company's status in each state. Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.
Just select a state on your compliance dashboard and we'll take care of it for you.
Unlimited incoming mail, scans, recycling ... Unlimited digital storage
Digitize files in-app & send via paper mail
Why manage eight different tools when you can have everything in one place.
